reviewItem.question: For "0.86.0 / 2025-10-07: [!NOTE] This release introduces the status subresource (behind the `StatusForConfigurationResources` feature gate) for `ServiceMonitor`…", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.
